cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Every Glitch Is a Gift
cards.instruction: Turn every contradiction or failure into a surprising benefit of the impossible system.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. The office clock is dragging us backward. Excellent, we can attend the meeting we missed.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Too far. I haven't received the invitation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Extra preparation time. This clock understands workload.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Now it's before the booking. The boss wants my opinion: do we need this meeting?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Perfect. Tell her no. We've upgraded from attending on time to giving everyone their afternoon back.

mechanism: A corrects a colleague's scheduling response while turning excessive time reversal into preparation and then eliminating the missed meeting.
confusable: D137 says this was planned; D164 embraces an unplanned glitch as a new benefit of the same impossible system.
comparison: Office scheduling and intervention before booking differ from picnic supply handling.
seedUse: Keep pre-invitation and pre-booking changes; give B concrete calendar actions for A to correct.
